'''Sarnok''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], sold [[Starship/Legends|starship]] upgrades on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].
